name: cyclotomy
description: A provenance-aware workspace checkpointer for Pi Coding Agent.
author: Henri

scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts .github package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts README.md README.zh.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts .github package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts README.md README.zh.md
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify && npm run test:package
